name: Badge
summary: A small pill that labels status, category, or count. Always paired with a label or shape.

leadingDot.description: Defaults true for status variants, false for neutral. For real-time freshness indicators, prefer composing <LiveDot size={6} hideLabel /> as a child instead — leadingDot renders a static dot; LiveDot ring-pulses on a 3 s loop to communicate liveness.

rules: Status meaning must live in the label. Color reinforces, never replaces.
For badges whose value changes in real time, wrap parent in aria-live='polite'.

do: Pair with LiveDot for real-time states (e.g. <Badge status='neutral'><LiveDot size={6} hideLabel />Refreshed 12 s ago</Badge>).
Wrap any in-badge digits in <span className='lumen-tnum'> so the chip width holds steady as values advance.
dont: Don't use accent green for non-action statuses.
Don't use red for non-error contexts.
Don't put 4+ badges in a row — use BadgeGroup.

Don't pair status='neutral' with bare text on a Card surface and expect chrome — pre-v0.11.15 the bg matched --surface-raised exactly and the pill disappeared. v0.11.15 re-anchored --pill-neutral-bg to a paper-alpha so the chip reads on every surface; if you write a custom badge-shaped chrome locally, mirror this.

changelog.note: v0.11.15 — neutral pill bg re-anchored to a paper-alpha overlay (was --lumen-obsidian-7, identical to --surface-raised, which made the pill chrome invisible on Card surfaces). Border bumped a08 -> a16 so the chip carries visible chrome even when the alpha overlay is at the perceptual floor. Resolved fg contrast on raised: ~13.4:1 — AAA. Static neutral badges with no status now read on canvas, raised, popover, and sunken alike.
